core_obligations: Note that all c'_p(Q) are defined because the zero sheaf has rank less than 1, and reduce to the analogous polynomial relation for the restricted classes on E using Lemma labelled lemma-silly-compose (proof lines 10449-10462).

Rewrite the products of the a_p in terms of the b_p using the description of the multiplication in Remark labelled remark-res-push, Lemma labelled lemma-silly and Lemma labelled lemma-homomorphism (proof lines 10464-10490).
Show that both sides of the desired identity reduce to the same expression (E -> Z)_* o c'_{p_1}(Q|_E) o c_{p_2}(Q|_{W_infinity}) o ... o c_{p_r}(Q|_{W_infinity}) o C (proof lines 10492-10496).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to the restricted classes over E (proof lines 10449-10462).
Unwinding the product structure for r > 1 (proof lines 10474-10490).
Common form of both sides (proof lines 10492-10496).
difficulty_reason: In the setting of Lemma labelled lemma-localized-chern-pre with the additional assumption that Q|_T is zero, the lemma asserts the explicit polynomial relations P'_1(Q) = c'_1(Q), P'_2(Q) = c'_1(Q)^2 - 2c'_2(Q), P'_3(Q) = c'_1(Q)^3 - 3c'_1(Q)c'_2(Q) + 3c'_3(Q) and P'_4(Q) = c'_1(Q)^4 - 4c'_1(Q)^2c'_2(Q) + 4c'_1(Q)c'_3(Q) + 2c'_2(Q)^2 - 4c'_4(Q), and so on, with the multiplication of Remark labelled remark-ring-loc-classes (statement lines 10435-10447). The proof first notes that the statement makes sense because the zero sheaf has rank less than 1 so all c'_p(Q) are defined, and recalls that P'_p(Q) and c'_p(Q) were built from the class C and the restricted classes on E, so that Lemma labelled lemma-silly-compose already gives the desired relation between P'_p(Q|_E) and c'_p(Q|_E) (proof lines 10449-10462). Since P'_p(Q) = (E -> Z)_* o P'_p(Q|_E) o C and c'_p(Q) = (E -> Z)_* o c'_p(Q|_E) o C, it suffices to show that the products of the a_p = c'_p(Q) agree with the pushforward-composed products of the b_p = c'_p(Q|_E), and for r > 1 the proof unwinds the multiplication of Remark labelled remark-ring-loc-classes as insertions of the pushforwards between factors (Remark labelled remark-res-push), uses (E -> W_infinity)_* o b_{p_i} = c_{p_i}(Q|_{W_infinity}) from Lemma labelled lemma-silly and C o (Z -> X)_* o a_{p_i} = c_{p_i}(Q|_{W_infinity}) o C from Lemma labelled lemma-homomorphism for i >= 2, and observes that both sides of the desired equality reduce to (E -> Z)_* o c'_{p_1}(Q|_E) o c_{p_2}(Q|_{W_infinity}) o ... o c_{p_r}(Q|_{W_infinity}) o C (proof lines 10464-10496; the author inserts 'Some details omitted' before handling r > 1 while the reduction itself is written out). Controlling the nested insertions of the pushforwards in the product to make the two expressions coincide is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
